ui.bestiary.title: BESTIARY
ui.bestiary.help:
Bestiary
Every enemy you defeat (solo or in a group) is added here, for the whole account. The profile shows its family, what it is weak to, what it resists and what it is immune to.
In battle, hover over an enemy to see its profile; if you have never defeated it you will see "???".
Search and filters only see what you have discovered.
Up / down arrows: move through the list · Tab: filters / search.
